_meta.source: 用户 2026-09-25 提供的游戏内图鉴截图（14 张植物详情页）+ 卡槽栏截图
note: cost 优先取卡槽栏上显示的价格（当前对局的真实值），图鉴页的『花费』记在 almanac_cost。
已知不一致：向日葵女王卡面 600 / 图鉴 500；豌豆射手卡面 125 / 原版 100。
cooldown_s 来自图鉴『冷却速度』，用于绑定校验：cd_total(tick) 应约等于 cooldown_s * 100。
tags 是给 policy.py 用的机器可读标签，effect_en 是给 Jev 看的英文效果说明。

向日葵女王.effect_en: Sun engine that also fights. Produces 150 sun every 25s, burns zombies in the 3x3 area around itself for 40 damage/s, and fires homing fireballs at any lane.
effects: 灼烧周围3×3的僵尸，造成40/s伤害

冰瓜香蒲.effect_en: Full-screen homing shooter that can hit any lane. Every hit slows the target, and 40% of its shots are a deep-freeze melon.

狂野机枪射手.effect_en: Heavy lane shooter. Fires a five-way spread of 20x4 shrapnel peas down its own lane every 2s; the spread means it still lands hits even when the lane is crowded.

阳光炸弹.effect_en: One-shot bomb. 1800 damage in a 1.5-cell circle around itself, and every zombie it destroys is converted into sun instead of just dying.
effects: 自身为中心周围1.5格的圆

樱桃辣椒.effect_en: One-shot bomb covering its own lane plus the two adjacent lanes, 1800 damage each. Also melts ice trails and cancels freeze slowdown. Long 100s cooldown, so it is a real commitment.
effects: 自身所在一整行和相邻两行

雪花寒冰菇.effect_en: Board-wide panic button. Rains ice on every zombie for 8s (20x100/s), then freezes the whole board for 3s and slows everything for another 15s. 4000 hp, so it can be planted out in the open.
effects: 之后冻结全场3秒并减速15秒

高冰果.effect_en: 8000 hp blocker that also shoots down its lane (20x8 every 1.5s). Attack and reflect both slow; reflect can freeze. Survives 8 hammer/crush hits. On death it releases an ice-shroom freeze. Price rises by 100 for every one already on the board.
effects: 可抵御8次锤击/碾压，每次扣血1000
受到外部寒冰菇效果回复1000血量
破损/亡语：释放寒冰菇效果
至尊金卡：场上每有一株该植物，价格增加100

雷果子.effect_en: 4000 hp blocker with ranged lightning: 60 damage every 1.5s, doubled against armour, with a 25% chance to stun for 1s. Immune to lethal damage - instead it loses 800 hp and explodes for 800. Zombies biting it take 80/s reflect damage.
effects: 免疫致命伤害，改为失去800血并爆炸反弹800
反伤对啃咬自己的僵尸80/s

回收高坚果.effect_en: Cheap 8000 hp blocker that also stops jumper zombies. Unlike normal walls it can be reclaimed: shovelling it costs 800 hp and returns it to your hand as a card with whatever hp it had left.
effects: 每次铲除时扣除800血，若此时血量大于0，则变为卡片（保留当前血量）

Cupid魅惑菇射手.effect_en: Temporary charmer: lives 15s only, firing 3 charm bullets every 2s. A charmed zombie fights for you. Heavy armour absorbs one bullet; the zombie-catcher vehicle instead takes 1800 damage. Does nothing to stun-immune helmets. 150s cooldown, so it is a one-per-wave trump card.
effects: 每2秒发射三枚魅惑子弹
二类防具会抵消一次击中
冰车巨人改为造成1800伤害

玉米卷香蒲.effect_en: Full-screen homing shooter that fires four tracking projectiles (corn, cattail, cabbage, butter) at any lane, with a chance to fire butter that stuns.

冰冻坚果.effect_en: Cheap blocker that also shoots two ice peas every 1.5s. Whatever bites it is slowed and takes 20/s reflect. On death it freezes everything in a 3x3 area for 3s and slows for 20s. Can be evolved into Tall Ice Fruit.
effects: 对啃咬的僵尸造成减速和每秒20反伤
亡语：冻结3×3范围内所有僵尸3秒和20秒减速

阳光向日葵.effect_en: Cheap sun engine and the backbone of the economy. Pays 40 sun between 3 and 12.5s after planting, then 40 sun every 25s; after 120s it grows up and pays 75 sun every 25s.
effects: 120秒后长大，长大后每25秒生产75阳光

寒光菇.effect_en: One-shot global freeze: releases an ice-shroom effect over the whole board, and produces 15 sun for every zombie it freezes. Doubles as an economy card when the board is crowded.
effects: 一次性植物，释放寒冰菇效果
每冻结一个僵尸生产15阳光

睡莲.effect_en: Platform plant. Must be placed first on a water tile before anything else can go there.

豌豆射手.effect_en: The cheapest attacker in this deck. 20 damage every 1.4s straight down its own lane, and only a 7.5s cooldown so it can be spammed.
